items.title: How we built the first stack-aware merge queue (and why it matters)

body.objective: How do merge queues and stacked-PR systems (GitHub merge queue, Graphite, Aviator, Mergify, Bors-style) handle very high PR volume from agents? What is known about throughput, CI cost and conflict rates when agents open hundreds of PRs a day? Pages that should rank first are primary sources: the vendors' and organisations' own engineering blog posts, documentation, conference talks, papers and open-source code (GitHub, Graphite, Aviator, Mergify, Bors/Bors-NG, Uber SubmitQueue, Zuul), plus credible reporting. Pull out mechanisms (batching, speculative or parallel queues, optimistic merging, bisection on failure, stacked-PR rebasing), concrete numbers (throughput, queue wait times, CI cost, flakiness, conflict and failure rates), names, dates, measured results, and failure modes when AI agents generate high PR volume.
